name: The Geneware Harvest: Unregulated Trials in the Outer Stack
description: Shot over three years by documentarian Yuki Abara-Szczepański using equipment disguised as standard mesh relay hardware, this film documents a series of unlicensed geneware trials conducted on Outer Stack residents between 2200 and 2204 by contractors with demonstrable financial ties to HelixCorp's Applied Geneware Division, though direct corporate authorization cannot be proven. The subjects — predominantly unregistered residents with no legal standing to file complaints — were offered food ration upgrades and housing stability credits in exchange for participation in what they were told were 'nutritional supplement studies.' Several subjects developed permanent dermal and neurological modifications they did not consent to.
cultural_impact: Abara-Szczepański's death became a galvanizing event for underground documentary culture, and the film itself is considered a sacred text in anti-corporate activist networks, passed between trusted individuals on unmarked physical media.
story_hooks: One of the documented trial subjects is still alive and visibly marked by the unauthorized modifications — and has recently begun speaking publicly, suggesting either extraordinary courage or that someone wants them to be visible.
A player acquires evidence suggesting Abara-Szczepański's death was not corporate-ordered but was carried out by someone protecting a different secret entirely.
The contractor firm used in the trials was dissolved in 2205, but its principals are still operating under new corporate identities — and one of them is about to receive a major public award.
